svg.title: The range of the nuclear force
svg.desc: A nucleus drawn as a cluster of nucleons. A dashed circle around one nucleon at its edge shows the range of the nuclear force: only the nucleons inside the circle feel that nucleon’s nuclear attraction directly. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Nuclear attraction falls away faster than Coulomb repulsion
A qualitative range comparison for r ≥ r0. The nuclear curve is an illustrative exponential, not a
fitted nucleon potential; both magnitudes are normalized independently.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
